subject: general
question: Information and Communication Technology(ICT), now integrated under RMSA, was launched in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2004.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in Schools was launched in December **2004.**__
 
• It was redesigned in 2010 to give secondary school pupils more possibilities to develop their ICT skills and learn through a computer-assisted learning process.
 
• The Scheme is a primary driver in bridging the digital divide among students from a variety of socioeconomic and geographic backgrounds.
 
• The Scheme assists states and local governments in establishing long-term computer labs.
 
• The Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in schools have been subsumed in the **Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA).**
 
• Now ICT in Schools is a component of the RMSA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA)** scheme was launched in March **2009.**
 
• It is a centrally sponsored scheme of the** Ministry of Human Resource Development**, Government of India.
 
• It was launched to enhance access to secondary education and to improve its quality.
 
• The scheme's implementation began in 2009-2010 with the goal of creating circumstances for efficient growth, development, and equity for all.
 
• Its goal is to provide universal education to all children **aged 15 to 16.**
 
• The central ministry funds are channelled through state governments, which set up their own implementation organisations.
